summary: Effigent: approve agent actions in Slack or Teams
description: Triggered by an Effigent webhook (approval.requested). Re-reads the request from Effigent, posts it to Slack and/or Microsoft Teams with Approve / Deny buttons, waits, and sends the decision back. Set the Slack/Teams target in the 'ask' step and the Effigent resource (default f/effigent/workspace) in 'current' and 'decide'. A timeout does nothing: the request expires in Effigent and the action stays blocked.

type.description: Effigent event type (sent by the webhook)

data.description: Effigent event data (sent by the webhook)

id.description: Effigent event id (sent by the webhook)

modules.summary: Re-read the request from Effigent (never trust the webhook body alone)
Ask in Slack / Teams and wait (set the Slack resource + channel, or the Teams team + channel, here)
Approve, deny, or let it expire
